updates.currentTarget: Bearbeiten von BackIssue Server
updates.target: BackIssue-Server bearbeiten
updates.rootRationale: Both reviewers selected this action label. The edit modal title needs an imperative; the compound BackIssue-Server is grammatical German.

updates.currentTarget: العنوان الاختيائي الذي يمكن لمستعمليكم أن يفتحوه من مصففهم
updates.target: عنوان اختياري يمكن لمستخدميك فتحه في متصفحهم.
updates.rootRationale: Choose the blind wording because it retains the source's possessive your users. It also fixes the misspelled optional and browser terms; the current مصففهم means hairdresser/stylist.

updates.currentTarget: 輸入合法 HTTP 或 HTTPS URL.
updates.target: 請輸入有效的 HTTP 或 HTTPS URL。
updates.rootRationale: Choose the primary correction: valid URL is better expressed as 有效的 than 合法, and the polite request fits this validation caller. HTTP, HTTPS, and URL remain exact.

updates.currentTarget: होस्टनाम या आईपी पता
updates.target: होस्टनाम या IP पता
updates.rootRationale: Both reviewers restored the protected literal IP. This field label must retain the exact protocol acronym.

updates.currentTarget: Introduzca un nombre de host válido o dirección IP.
updates.target: Introduzca un nombre de host válido o una dirección IP válida.
updates.rootRationale: Choose the blind correction. The current target omits una before dirección and does not repeat válida for the IP option.

updates.currentTarget: SeerrNG sendet BackIssue das komplette ComicVine-Volume. BackIssue verwendet eigene Quellen und Download-Einstellungen, um Ausgaben zu finden und zu verfolgen.
updates.target: SeerrNG sendet den vollständigen ComicVine-Band an BackIssue. BackIssue nutzt eigene Quellen und Download-Einstellungen, um Ausgaben zu finden und zu verfolgen.
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary refinement: Band is the natural German term for a comic volume, and the rest preserves the source/BackIssue division of responsibilities.

updates.currentTarget: SeerrNG envoie le volume ComicVine complet à BackIssue. BackIssue utilise ses propres sources et paramètres de téléchargement pour trouver et suivre les numéros.
updates.target: SeerrNG envoie le volume complet de ComicVine à BackIssue. BackIssue utilise ses propres sources et paramètres de téléchargement pour trouver et suivre les numéros.
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary refinement because it fixes French noun/adjective order and makes the ComicVine relation grammatical.

updates.currentTarget: SeerrNG gửi toàn bộ volume ComicVine cho BackIssue. BackIssue dùng nguồn và cài đặt tải xuống riêng để tìm và theo dõi từng số truyện.
updates.target: SeerrNG gửi toàn bộ tập truyện ComicVine cho BackIssue. BackIssue dùng các nguồn và cài đặt tải xuống riêng để tìm và theo dõi từng số truyện.
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary refinement: tập truyện expresses a comics volume more clearly than the English loan volume; BackIssue remains responsible for finding/tracking issues.

updates.currentTarget: SeerrNG mengirimkan seluruh volume ComicVine ke BackIssue. BackIssue menggunakan sumber dan pengaturan unduhannya sendiri untuk menemukan dan melacak edisi.
updates.target: SeerrNG mengirim seluruh jilid ComicVine ke BackIssue. BackIssue menggunakan sumber dan pengaturan unduhannya sendiri untuk menemukan dan melacak nomor terbitan.
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary refinement: jilid localizes volume and nomor terbitan distinguishes issues that BackIssue finds/tracks.

updates.currentTarget: 输入此服务器的名称 。
updates.target: 请输入此服务器的名称。
updates.rootRationale: Choose the primary instruction form over the blind's punctuation-only repair. The caller is a required-field validation, so 请输入 is an appropriate direct prompt.

updates.currentTarget: このサーバーの名前を入力します。
updates.target: このサーバーの名前を入力してください。
updates.rootRationale: Choose the blind correction. The caller is required-field validation; 入力してください is a natural polite request, unlike the current declarative 入力します.

updates.currentTarget: 이 서버에 이름을 입력하십시오.
updates.target: 이 서버의 이름을 입력하세요.
updates.rootRationale: Choose the blind correction. The caller is required-field validation; the possessive name-of-this-server form is natural, unlike the current directional 에 construction.

updates.currentTarget: 輸入此伺服器的名稱 。
updates.target: 請輸入此伺服器的名稱。
updates.rootRationale: Choose the primary instruction form over the blind's punctuation-only repair. The caller is a required-field validation, so 請輸入 is an appropriate direct prompt.

updates.currentTarget: Masukkan sebuah nomor port yang valid.
updates.target: Masukkan nomor port yang valid.
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary refinement. Dropping sebuah keeps the port validation meaning and makes this concise Indonesian UI instruction more natural.

updates.currentTarget: Mantenga la disponibilidad de SeerrNG en sincronización
updates.target: Mantenga sincronizada la disponibilidad de SeerrNG
updates.rootRationale: Both reviewers selected this target. It removes the awkward en sincronización calque while preserving the checkbox instruction.

updates.currentTarget: 保持 SeerrNG 的可用状态同步
updates.target: 让 SeerrNG 的可用状态保持同步
updates.rootRationale: Choose the primary correction because the current wording attaches 同步 awkwardly. This states that SeerrNG availability should remain synchronized.

updates.currentTarget: 同期でSeerrNG の可用性を維持
updates.target: SeerrNG の可用性を同期した状態に保つ
updates.rootRationale: Choose the blind wording because it preserves the source's keep-in-sync meaning; the primary alternative only says to synchronize availability.

updates.currentTarget: Maintenir la disponibilité SeerrNG en synchronisation
updates.target: Maintenir la disponibilité de SeerrNG synchronisée
updates.rootRationale: Choose the blind wording for a formal settings label. It corrects the missing de and replaces the awkward en synchronisation construction.

updates.currentTarget: SeerrNG의 가용성을 동기화 상태로 유지
updates.target: SeerrNG의 가용성을 동기화된 상태로 유지
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary refinement. 동기화된 상태로 유지 is a grammatical way to express keeping availability in a synchronized state.

updates.currentTarget: 保持 SeerrNG 的可用狀態同步
updates.target: 讓 SeerrNG 的可用狀態保持同步
updates.rootRationale: Choose the primary correction because the current wording attaches 同步 awkwardly; the proposed sentence clearly expresses keeping the availability state synchronized.

updates.currentTarget: Pertahankan ketersediaan SeerrNG dalam sinkronisasi
updates.target: Jaga agar ketersediaan SeerrNG tetap tersinkronisasi
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary wording. Jaga agar … tetap tersinkronisasi clearly expresses keeping availability synchronized in Indonesian.

updates.currentTarget: Escanea la colección de cómics existentes y muestra descargas activas de BackIssue en estado de solicitud.
updates.target: Escanea la colección para buscar cómics existentes y muestra las descargas activas de BackIssue en el estado de la solicitud.
updates.rootRationale: Choose the blind correction because it retains the scan action while clarifying that the scan searches for existing comics; this stays closer to the source than the primary's Busca.

updates.currentTarget: 扫描现有漫画的收藏,并在请求状态下显示活动的 BackIssue 下载.
updates.target: 扫描收藏库以查找现有漫画，并在请求状态中显示正在进行的 BackIssue 下载。
updates.rootRationale: Synthesize the stronger parts of both proposals: 收藏库 makes the collection/library explicit, and 正在进行的 naturally describes active downloads; retain natural Chinese punctuation.

updates.currentTarget: 既存のコミックのコレクションをスキャンし、要求のステータスでアクティブなBackIssueのダウンロードを表示します。
updates.target: コレクションをスキャンして既存のコミックを探し、リクエストのステータスにBackIssueの進行中のダウンロードを表示します。
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary refinement. 探し expresses finding comics in the scan, リクエスト is the usual UI term, and 進行中 describes active downloads.

updates.currentTarget: Scanner la collection pour les bandes dessinées existantes et afficher les téléchargements BackIssue actifs dans le statut de demande.
updates.target: Analysez la collection à la recherche des bandes dessinées existantes et affichez les téléchargements BackIssue actifs dans le statut de la demande.
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary correction. Its paired imperatives match the source's paired instructions and its phrasing clearly says to scan for existing comics.

updates.currentTarget: Pindai koleksi komik yang ada dan tampilkan pengunduhan BackIssue aktif dalam status permintaan.
updates.target: Pindai koleksi untuk menemukan komik yang sudah ada dan tampilkan unduhan BackIssue yang sedang aktif di status permintaan.
updates.rootRationale: Choose the blind correction because it explicitly says to scan the collection to find existing comics; the primary wording still reads like scanning a collection of comics.

updates.currentTarget: Tak bisa menyimpan server BackIssue.
updates.target: Tidak dapat menyimpan server BackIssue.
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary refinement. Tidak dapat matches the more formal register of the adjacent BackIssue connection-failure message; Tak bisa is colloquial.

updates.currentTarget: BackIssue에 연결할 수 없습니다. 주소 및 API 키 확인.
updates.target: BackIssue에 연결할 수 없습니다. 주소와 API 키를 확인하세요.
updates.rootRationale: Accept the primary refinement. It preserves the error and turns the abrupt 확인 fragment into a clear polite instruction.
